title: Document automatic federation SSH recovery stages and fixed reasons
outcome: Connection diagnostics documentation explains automatic cleanup and recovery and accurately describes the existing read-only worker projection.
acceptance: The satellite onboarding Connection diagnostics section describes automatic recovery after proven no-child or exact-child reap, and documents sshStartSettlement, sshCleanupPending, sshCleanupRetry, sshRecovered and recoveryReason without implying permanent quarantine or a new operator action.
Documentation distinguishes current-basis observation from stale-basis or transient observations and is reviewed against the production contract. No Markdown phrase-pinning tests are added.
